import numpy as np

vectors = np.array([[1, 2, 3],
                    [2, 4, 6],
                    [1, 0, -1],
                    [0, 1, 2]])

rank = np.linalg.matrix_rank(vectors)

Q, R = np.linalg.qr(vectors)

basis = Q[:, :rank]

b = np.array([3, 6, 2, 3])
coefficients, residuals, _, _ = np.linalg.lstsq(vectors, b, rcond=None)

projection = vectors @ coefficients

residual_vector = b - projection

print(f"Rank: {rank}")
print(f"Basis vectors:\n{basis}")
print(f"Coefficients: {coefficients}")
print(f"Projection: {projection}")
print(f"Residual norm: {np.linalg.norm(residual_vector):.6f}")
